message: スノードーム
I walk down the narrow path, heading toward Finis Tower.
It's awfully cold today. With less than a month left until Christmas, the air already carries the chill of midwinter.

name: Synn
message: 「Yeah, I'm glad I came to scout it out. It's right in the center of the academy, so it's fitting to be the main venue for the Holy Night Festival」

name: Helena
message: 「For you, Synn-chan, it might as well be the center of the world, too」

name: Synn
message: 「H-Helena-san? Why are you in a place like this... Are you alone?」

name: Helena
message: 「Heeey, it's Helena, taking a stroll while picturing the future of her adorable students\s04」

name: Synn
message: 「The future? You mean the Holy Night Festival?」

name: Helena
message: 「Bzz-bzz-bzzzz!」

name: Helena
message: 「What I was thinking about is how everyone will be even further ahead♪ Because if we can prevent Re-Crea, a future will come to the entire world」

name: Helena
message: 「And what's more, that future isn't set in just one form. Just as you and the others have all kinds of possibilities, the world's future is infinite too」

name: Synn
message: 「Guh... Please don't put that kind of pressure on me」

name: Helena
message: 「Oh my? You're not the kind of boy to get discouraged over something like this, are you?」

name: Helena
message: 「Try imagining your future relationships with your friends. I'm sure it'll get you fired up to fight」

name: Synn
message: 「U-Umm...」
Me as a human, me as the Demon Lord. Which side does the future belong to?

name: Helena
message: 「Ufufu. For thinking things over, this spot is even more ideal than the library, isn't it?」

name: Synn
message: 「You think so? It's completely exposed to the wind--we're going to freeze, you know?」

name: Helena
message: 「Yes, after all, a first snow that isn't quite a first snow is falling」

name: Helena
message: 「Look really closely. Right beneath the clouds... See those specks of light sparkling?」

name: Synn
message: 「Ah!? Y-You're right... Countless little specks like silver dust are floating there」

name: Helena
message: 「No, those aren't floating--they're falling. It's just that the air is so dry they evaporate partway down」

name: Synn
message: 「I-I didn't know snow like this existed...」

name: Helena
message: 「Snow that falls in secret without ever reaching the ground... It might even be piling up near the top of Finis Tower」

name: Helena
message: 「This tower has put down the deepest roots in Ryuusei Town」

name: Helena
message: 「You and I have family, Synn-chan. The kids at the dorm have hometowns to go back to, and even Melilot has her own memories」

name: Helena
message: 「Yet nothing remains in this tower. No human dignity, not a trace of blood, nails, or hair... Even the name Finis was just given for convenience--we don't know a single thing for sure」

name: Helena
message: 「Even if the tower were to crumble away, I doubt anyone would shed a tear」

name: Synn
message: 「Helena-san? We were supposed to be talking about the future, so how did the topic subtly shift to the past?」

name: Helena
message: 「The future is something protected by the past, you know?」

name: Synn
message: 「T-That's a bit too deep for me...」

name: Synn
message: 「When someone brings up the future, at most, let's see... all I can picture are this year's Christmas presents」

name: Synn
message: 「Like what to give to whom, and what I might get from who...」

name: Helena
message: 「Hee-hee-hee\s04 That's more than enough」

name: Helena
message: 「Ah, I've been waiting for a while now, and it really isn't going to snow after all」
Helena-san looks up at the blue sky once more. No, she had probably been looking up at it over and over even before I got here.

name: Helena
message: 「...When I was little, my mother used to give me a Christmas present every year. Out of all of them, the one that stayed with me the most is a snow globe」

name: Synn
message: 「A snow globe--you mean those glass balls with a little scene inside where stuff like powdery snow falls?」

name: Helena
message: 「Yes, that's the one」

name: Helena
message: 「I have no idea where she bought it, but inside the glass dome was a Western-style mansion that looked just like the Kujou estate」

name: Helena
message: 「Lights were glowing in the rooms visible through the windows, filled with the aroma of delicious food and everyone's laughter」

name: Helena
message: 「When you turned the dome upside down, the snow would fall gently as if wrapping around everything... eventually piling up on the ground, quietly watching over everyone」

name: Helena
message: 「...No matter how hard you shook it, the snow could never get outside」

name: Helena
message: 「As a child, I couldn't stand it anymore, so I broke the snow globe's glass」

name: Helena
message: 「The instant I did, that world was lost. What had looked like snow was just some unidentifiable, thick liquid... and I could never put it back together」

name: Helena
message: 「But you know, lately I've been thinking: instead of trying to get out of that world, couldn't I have stepped inside it instead?」

name: Synn
message: 「A snow globe future, huh? You daydream about some pretty cute things, don't you, Helena-san?」

name: Helena
message: 「Oh, come now, Synn-chan, 'quite' is unnecessary. Besides, you should save lines like that for Ria.」

name: Synn
message: achoo!」

name: Helena
message: 「Hehe, perhaps I've chatted a bit too much. Come to the chairwoman's office. I'll brew us some piping hot tea.」

name: Synn
message: 「I'd love that, thank you.」
I follow after Helena-san, leaving the hilltop behind.
Before I knew it, the mysterious snow had stopped falling.
......It wasn't until much later that I finally understood the meaning behind Helena-san's words.
